subject: Coordinating calibration call: ops / procurement / engineering
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@stratusbio.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: K. Patel <kpatel@stratusbio.com>, procurements@stratusbio.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — scheduling intake with engineering and procurement

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the intro — happy to coordinate. We (Stratus Bio) are excited to see a short technical calibration before a formal demo. Stakeholders who should attend:
- Me (customer champion, product integrations)
- K. Patel (engineering lead, will validate performance/latency)
- Procurement (copied) and our security reviewer (may join for a portion)

Requested goals for the call: align on success criteria, data flows, compliance needs (SOC2 / data retention), and confirm what materials procurement needs before a purchasing conversation.

Available windows next week (PST):
- Tue 1/12: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed 1/13: 09:00–12:00 (preferred)

If possible please include an SE and an AE; a short agenda would help.

Thanks,
Priya

Priya Shah
Product Integrations, Stratus Bio
priya@stratusbio.com
(415) 555-2710

[Attachment: vendor-questionnaire.docx (form)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@stratusbio.com>
Cc: K. Patel <kpatel@stratusbio.com>, procurements@stratusbio.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — scheduling intake with engineering and procurement

Hi Priya — great, thanks for the windows and context. I can run the call as AE; I’ll invite Soojin (SE) and ask Marcus (engineering) to be on standby if K. wants deeper bench-level detail.

Proposed slots from our side (PST):
- Wed 1/13 09:30–10:15 (short calibration)
- Wed 1/13 11:00–12:00 (longer, include procurement)
- Thu 1/14 14:00–15:00 (backup)

Attached is a short pre-demo checklist we use to make these productive — can you confirm what you want covered and whether your security reviewer needs SOC2/pen-test artefacts in advance?

Agenda (30–45m suggested):
1) Intros + roles (5m)
2) Top success criteria and data flow (10m)
3) Security/compliance Qs from procurement (10m)
4) Next steps & procurement ask list (10m)

I’ll tentatively hold Wed 1/13 11:00–12:00 on our calendar until we confirm.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com
[Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@stratusbio.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — scheduling intake with engineering and procurement

Priya / Alex — Soojin here (SE). A couple quick notes so we can prioritize agenda items:
- If K. wants to validate latency/throughput, can you share a short example payload size and expected QPS? Even ballpark helps (e.g., 60 token prompts vs 600 tokens).
- For SOC2 / compliance, we typically provide the audit summary and our SOC2 cert (redacted). If the reviewer needs deeper evidence (e.g., network diagrams), let us know and we’ll prepare.
- Marcus is happy to join for the engineering deep dive but expects prep questions; tagging him for scheduling.

My availability for Wed 1/13: 09:30–12:00. Prefer the 11:00 slot if procurement will be on.

Thanks — Soojin
SoojIn Lee (she/her)
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Priya Shah <priya@stratusbio.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: K. Patel <kpatel@stratusbio.com>, procurements@stratusbio.com, security@stratusbio.com
Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — scheduling intake with engineering and procurement

Alex / Soojin — thanks, 11:00–12:00 on Wed 1/13 works for the core group. Procurement wants the vendor questionnaire completed before the meeting (attached). Security may dial in for the first 15 minutes.

K. — can you confirm whether you or someone from engineering will run a quick perf sample during the call or if you prefer us to send sample traffic afterwards?

I’ll route the completed questionnaire to procurements and security once it’s filled.

Best,
Priya

[Attachment: vendor-questionnaire.docx (form)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — scheduling intake with engineering and procurement

Quick heads up — I have a conflict on Wed 1/13 11:00–12:00 (critical infra review). I can join 09:30–10:15 on Wed or Thu 1/14 14:00–15:00. If the team prefers Wed 11:00 with procurement present, I can still join for the last 20 minutes (after my review concludes).

If K. wants deep perf discussion I recommend Thu 1/14 14:00 when I can block a full hour and bring logs / run a small throughput test.

—Marcus

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@stratusbio.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, procurements@stratusbio.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Confirmed: Calibration call Thu 1/14 14:00–15:00 PST — agenda + materials

Priya / team — thanks for the flexibility. We’ll move forward with Thu 1/14 14:00–15:00 PST so Marcus can attend for a full hour. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Final agenda (45m–60m):
- 14:00–14:05: intros & roles (Alex / Priya)
- 14:05–14:20: success criteria & data flow (Priya + K.)
- 14:20–14:40: technical architecture & perf expectations (Marcus + Soojin)
- 14:40–14:55: procurement & compliance Qs (Marissa to cover ask list)
- 14:55–15:00: next steps (Doc owners + timeline)

Attachments we’ve uploaded to the shared folder: SOW-draft-v1.pdf, pre-demo-checklist.xlsx.

Action items before the call:
- Alex: send short meeting invite (done) and confirm dial-in.
- Priya: circulate completed vendor questionnaire to procurements/security if possible.
- Marissa: bring procurement checklist and typical timeline for pilot contracting.

If anything changes please reply-all and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com
